decision.reason: Crop and livestock context is improved, but complete regional harvested-area/yield series, direct farmgate prices, verified input quotations and representative enterprise budgets remain missing. The 2026 Q2 crop allocation is unresolved.

next_actions: Extract the primary NSA Q2 2026 crop table and reconcile the 52,515-tonne aggregate with secondary crop allocations.
Extract NAB 2026 monthly horticulture price reports and classify market, date, grade, unit and transaction level.
Obtain current dated producer prices for white maize, wheat, tomatoes, watermelon and livestock; keep auction prices separate.
Verify the NAB 0.04 tonnes/ha Zambezi maize yield and its denominator/sample.
Crosswalk NAB production zones to the 14 administrative regions only where defensible.
Collect farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop protection, labour, machinery, irrigation, transport, feed and veterinary costs.
Validate enterprise budgets and all 17 commodity mappings before activation.
safeguards: Do not alter the original 10 working country profiles or calculator formulas.
Do not equate marketed purchases with total production or harvested area.
Do not treat auction prices, import-parity floor prices or retail/wholesale references as farmgate transactions.
Do not use the 2026 Q2 combined total as a crop-specific value.
Do not activate Namibia or publish a calculator test URL until mapping, build and regression tests pass.
